mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN c.category_name = 'その他' THEN 'その他' ELSE c.category_name END AS categoryName, SUM(s.spending_amount) AS totalAmount FROM tb_trn_spending s JOIN tb_mst_category c ON s.category_id = c.category_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.spending_date BETWEEN #{startOfMonth} AND #{endOfMonth} AND s.delete_flg = false GROUP BY CASE WHEN c.category_name = 'その他' THEN 'その他' ELSE c.category_name END ORDER BY totalAmount DESC
